title: Guard block segment phases
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j\in\mathbb N$ with $j\le |x|$. For any Boolean output string $out$, let $c$ be the guard configuration at position $j$ in phase zero, with output $out$. Its state is phase zero and its guard time is positive; moreover, for every natural number $u$ strictly between zero and that guard time, after $u$ steps the machine is in a state that is neither phase zero nor the halting state.
